# Vanity Phone Number Studio

> Spell, test, and generate memorable vanity phone numbers from words, word combos, and dev terms.
> Open source, local-first, and agent-native (REST + MCP).

The app turns a brief or explicit words into vanity numbers (e.g. `702-PROGRAM` = 702-776-4726),
decodes numbers back into words, generates bulk combos from themed word packs, and can verify
availability against Twilio's inventory.

## Install & run

- [README](https://github.com/MarioGiancini/vanity-phone-number/blob/main/README.md): setup, scripts, architecture.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/MarioGiancini/vanity-phone-number/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): dev setup and word packs.

## Agent API

- [Developers hub](/developers): all developer resources in one place.
- [Agent guide](/agents.md): when to use this, which tool to call, and tips.
- [Docs](/docs): human-readable API guide.
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description (typed error schema included).
- [API catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset.
- [Capability document](/api/agent): endpoints, themes, examples (no auth).
- [auth.md](/auth.md): how agents authenticate.

Endpoints:

- `POST /api/agent/find` — brief or explicit words → ranked vanity numbers; optional availability.
- `POST /api/agent/decode` — number → dictionary readings.
- `POST /api/agent/verify` — batch-verify words against Twilio inventory.
- `POST /api/availability` — single-number availability check (rate-limited).

## MCP

- Remote (Streamable HTTP): `POST /api/mcp` — `Authorization: Bearer $VANITY_AGENT_API_KEY`.
- [MCP server card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card): tools and transports.
- [server.json](/server.json): registry manifest.
- Local stdio server: `scripts/mcp-server.mjs`.

## About & trust

- [About](/about)
- [Privacy](/privacy): local-first, anonymous analytics with opt-out, bring-your-own carrier keys.
- [Terms](/terms)
- [security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/MarioGiancini/vanity-phone-number/blob/main/SECURITY.md)

## Optional configuration

- `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` + `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` — enable availability checks. Without them the
  availability path makes zero network calls.
- `VANITY_AGENT_API_KEY` — enable the `/api/agent/*` routes.
